name: @lit-core/dirty-mask
description: Ahead-of-time property-to-part dependency bitmasking compiler pass and bundler optimization for Lit and Web Components

scripts.build: cargo build --release && cp target/release/libdirty_mask.dylib dirty-mask.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null && (codesign -s - -f dirty-mask.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true) || true
scripts.build:debug: cargo build && cp target/debug/libdirty_mask.dylib dirty-mask.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null && (codesign -s - -f dirty-mask.darwin-arm64.node 2>/dev/null || true) || true
